Make it happen, prove it to yourself
Trust that you can achieve it

Leave the past behind. Focus on the present
Take the risk or lose the chance
Everything is hard before it gets easy
Anything is possible if you try

Compare yourself only to your past self
Don't need more time, need more focus
The best is yet to come
Work in silence. Let results speak
Keep working, no matter what others say
Sometimes it's better to let go
Discipline looks boring, until you succeed
It’s not how you start, it’s how you finish
Build a life you are proud of
Get out of your comfort zone
Don't let your past define your future
Face problems, and they will disappear
Be part of the 1% of people
What if you try and win?
Messy action is better than perfection
Start making a change in your life
Do it even when you're unmotivated
You can do that. Stay consistent
Take failures as small steps to success
Hard work today, easy life tomorrow
The only failure is not trying
The road to success is not that easy
Don't quit. You've already come so far
Keep trying, even if it's hard
Don't give up because of a bad day
If i stop, i will never be good #discipline
Only Some People Win. Be one
Small Steps Lead To Big Results
And They Still Call It Luck
Embrace the rise. Accept the fall
There's No Other Life. Do It Now
The Best Time To Start Is Now
Failure Today Is An Asset Tomorrow
Change the plan, but never the goal
Keep Going. The Path Will Apperar
A decision on time can change everything
It all depends on your mindset
Don't look back, you're not going that way
Do it tired. Do it alone. Do it scared
Try it. No matter what others say
Try breaking it down into small steps
If you don't try, you can't win
There's a first time for everything
Respect the process to achieve success
Life is not a straight line
God's plan is waiting for you
Remember how far you have come
Not everything is as easy as it looks
It's not wrong to take a different path
If you never try, you will never know
A fall isn't failure, it’s a chance to reach higher
Never give up, keep up the hard work
Everything happens at the right time
There is progress in every single day
The first step is always the hardest one
You are going to make it
That person who always has your back
You are closer to success every single day
Let the right people into your life
Many Will Congratulate Your Success, But Few Will Help You In The Process
It’s not wrong to be different
A 9-5 job often keeps your dreams on pause
That person who always lifts you up
What you give is what you get
